{{Quote|Elite Lead to Virile Lead. Slack your speed and let Might Squadron join up with you.|Erisi Dlarit to Virile Lead|<ref name="BW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>}}
'''Virile Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]], operating under the [[Xucphra Corporation]]-controlled government led by former [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] Director [[Ysanne Isard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. The squadron flew [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]].<ref name="BW" />

During the [[Battle of Thyferra]], that marked the resolution of the [[Bacta War]], Virile Squadron lost ten starfighters on their first pass against Dlarit's former unit [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] due to their overconfidence.<ref name="BW" />
